entry_points.note: index.html:27 loads main.jsx; App.jsx:9 picks HashRouter when VITE_OFFLINE=1, else BrowserRouter. Although the router is URL-based it has one route; every view is in-memory state.
FastAPI app, GET-only; uvicorn server.backend.main:app --port 8000 (dashboard/src/lib/api.js:2). CORS allows :5173 plus ALLOWED_ORIGINS (main.py:33-36).
Delegates to the external prii_desktop package (not in this repository); config in desktop/config.py:14-32. Same-origin ASGI app at desktop/app_server.py:20.
Creates .venv, installs requirements, builds the frontend with VITE_API_BASE='' (setup.py:80).
Also PRII-OVNIS.command, PRII-OVNIS.bat, PRII-OVNIS.app; each runs desktop/setup.py --ensure then desktop/launch.py. Only the .sh was read.
VITE_OFFLINE=1 single-file build to export-standalone (vite.config.js:15-20); data from src/lib/snapshot.json.
iOS/Android shells around the offline build (package.json:16-18). README states native builds were never run (dashboard/README.md:86).

accessibility_source_findings.finding: On desktop the only ways to open a case are a mouse click on a <tr> that has no tabIndex, role or key handler, or a click on a map canvas point. The case detail cannot be opened from the keyboard or by a screen-reader user in the desktop shell.

A failed or still-pending /cases or /geojson request is presented as real emptiness ('0 of 0 cases', 'No cases found', '0 mapped sightings'). Only the small header text says 'backend unreachable'. Statistics and Candidates do distinguish the two states through QueryState.

The MapLibre container has no role or accessible name, and points, clusters and all three spatial tools respond only to pointer clicks. The Cases list is a text equivalent for the points themselves, but not for measure, buffer or nearest.

Both Recharts bar charts expose their per-decade and per-tier values only as SVG bars and hover tooltips; there is no table, list or accessibilityLayer. Only Total/Mapped/Unmapped are available as text.

Switching to Español sets <html lang='es'> while Statistics, Candidates, Activity, map controls, spatial tools, error states and the sheet 'Close' label stay English, so a screen reader pronounces them with the wrong language.

Evidence tier and confidence are bare badges ('T3', '0.2') with no visible or accessible label saying which is which; meaning is carried by position and colour. Confidence arrives as a number, so confidenceTone's high/medium/low palette never matches and every badge is slate.

CaseDetail sets no onCloseAutoFocus and is not opened from a focusable trigger on desktop (table row or map canvas), so focus has no meaningful element to return to on close. The More sheet does restore focus explicitly.
Programme-timeline phase filter buttons show the active filter by class only (no aria-pressed), the search input is named only by its placeholder, and decorative icons lack aria-hidden.

Controls reachable in the mobile shell without a 44px minimum: timeline filter and sort buttons (min-h-9), spatial-tool mode, radius and Clear buttons, the map 'Clear date filter' × and 'Retry density' link-button, the QueryState Retry button, and MapLibre's zoom control (no CSS override in index.css).
The case-list scroll container and the table wrapper are overflow-auto with no tabindex, so the region cannot be focused for keyboard scrolling.
The mobile branch wraps content in <main>; the desktop branch uses <div> and <aside> only. There is no skip link in either.
In the desktop table the 'no coordinates' icon passes a title prop to an SVG and has no aria-label, unlike the mobile card which uses aria-label.
The mapped-count legend and the spatial tools panel are both absolutely positioned at bottom-2 left-2 of the map area, so they occupy the same corner when tools are open.
The health dot conveys up/down by colour and pulse only; it is acceptable because the adjacent text (sr-only on mobile) states the same thing.

special_adjudications.question: 1a. Historical mobile defect: fixed 440px side pane overflows a 390px viewport and squeezes the map to 0px (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:128-151, citing Dashboard.jsx <aside w-[440px]>). Doc records a later repair: yes (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:120-126).
special_adjudications.answer: Fixed in current source. Below 860px Dashboard renders a separate mobile shell (one view at a time plus a bottom nav); the 440px aside exists only in the desktop branch. The breakpoint is shared by useIsMobile and the shell-mobile/shell-desktop CSS variants, and html/body/#root are capped at max-width 100%. Layout was not rendered in this audit.

special_adjudications.question: 1b. Historical mobile/desktop defect: axe button-name on the decade and tier Select triggers (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:153-172, citing CaseGrid.jsx). Doc records a later repair: yes (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:120-123).
special_adjudications.answer: Fixed in current source: both triggers carry aria-label (Period / Tier), the page-size trigger uses aria-labelledby, and the mobile layout adds visible captions.

special_adjudications.question: 1c. Historical defect: horizontal overflow at 390px on all four scripted states (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:102-107,140-142). Doc records a later repair: yes, as part of finding 1 (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:120-126).
special_adjudications.answer: Same root cause as 1a and fixed with it. A Playwright spec asserts no horizontal overflow at 430x932 and 844x390; it was not executed here.

special_adjudications.question: 1d. Historical defect: touch targets under 44px - tab triggers, MapLibre zoom buttons, Select triggers (28px), sheet Close (33px) (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:210-223). Doc records a later repair: no (the 2026-10-25 status note covers findings 1 and 2 only).
special_adjudications.answer: Partly fixed. Fixed on mobile: tab triggers are replaced by a 56px bottom nav, Select triggers and search are h-11, chips min-h-11, pager buttons 44px, sheet Close 44x44, map layer buttons min-h-11. Still present: MapLibre's zoom control has no size override, and newer controls have no mobile minimum (timeline filter/sort min-h-9, spatial-tool buttons, 'Clear date filter' ×, 'Retry density', QueryState Retry).

special_adjudications.question: 1e. Historical defect: scrollable-region-focusable on the case table scroll container, both viewports (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:186-193, citing CaseGrid.jsx). Doc records a later repair: no.
special_adjudications.answer: Still present in source: the list scroll container and the Table wrapper are overflow-auto without tabindex. Pagination (12 rows by default) reduces how often it overflows; 100 per page is still selectable. On mobile the cards are buttons, so focus can enter the region there; on desktop the rows are not focusable.

special_adjudications.question: 1f. Historical defect: link-in-text-block on MapLibre's attribution link, desktop viewport only (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:174-184). Doc records a later repair: no.
special_adjudications.answer: Not adjudicable from source. No .maplibregl-ctrl-attrib override exists in index.css (grep), so nothing in the app changes the third-party link styling; whether axe still flags it requires a run. On mobile the map is now visible, so the rule could now apply there too.

special_adjudications.question: 1g. Historical layout defect: Cases tab forces the page to ~11,300px and the map renders as a sliver because Tailwind 4 dropped zero-value utilities under the legacy @config shim (docs/GUI_AUDIT.md:168-205, 129-133). Doc records a later repair: no (the 2026-10-25 note at docs/GUI_AUDIT.md:10-16 describes control changes only).
special_adjudications.answer: Root cause removed in source: index.css now uses native '@import "tailwindcss"' with an @theme block, its comment names this exact failure, and dashboard/tailwind.config.js no longer exists. The list is also paginated instead of rendering 470 rows. Compiled CSS was not built or inspected.

special_adjudications.question: 1h. Historical latent defect: Toaster viewport would be mispositioned by the same missing utilities (docs/GUI_AUDIT.md:437-441). Doc records a later repair: no.
special_adjudications.answer: Root cause removed as in 1g and the viewport now positions itself above the mobile bottom nav. Still dormant: nothing calls toast().

special_adjudications.question: 1i. Historical scope note: no light theme exists (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:79-86).
special_adjudications.answer: No longer true: a light token set and a dark/light/system toggle exist. Light-theme contrast has not been audited by any document found.

special_adjudications.question: 2a. Case-detail defect: drawer renders entirely off-screen, Close and click-outside unreachable, only Escape works (docs/GUI_AUDIT.md:225-253, citing CaseDetail.jsx and ui/sheet.jsx). Doc records a later repair: no.
special_adjudications.answer: Root cause removed in source (see 1g). The sheet variants still use inset-y-0/right-0 and inset-x-0/bottom-0, which now compile under native Tailwind 4. A Playwright spec asserts the mobile bottom sheet settles against the viewport bottom; no spec asserts the desktop right-hand drawer's position, and nothing was run here.

special_adjudications.question: 2b. Case-detail defect: axe aria-hidden-focus while the sheet is open (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:195-208). Doc records a later repair: no.
special_adjudications.answer: Not adjudicable from source. The sheet is a stock Radix Dialog portal with no custom aria-hidden handling; whether a focusable background node remains inside an aria-hidden ancestor is a runtime property. No automated axe check covers the open case sheet (vitest-axe covers CaseGrid, MobileNav and TopControls only).

special_adjudications.question: 2c. Case-detail defect: sheet Close button below 44px (docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:216-218). Doc records a later repair: no.
special_adjudications.answer: Fixed for the mobile shell (44x44 under shell-mobile); unchanged icon-sized target on desktop.

special_adjudications.question: 2d. Current source: how a case is opened.
special_adjudications.answer: Three triggers, all setting one in-memory 'selected' object: desktop table row click, mobile card button, map point click. Detail is rendered from the row already in memory; GET /cases/{case_id} is never called. The desktop table row is not keyboard operable, so on desktop there is no keyboard route to the detail view.

special_adjudications.question: 2e. Current source: dialog/panel semantics, focus handling and close behaviour.
special_adjudications.answer: Radix Dialog (role=dialog, modal) with SheetTitle '{case_id} · {date_raw}' and SheetDescription (location). Close via the built-in Close button, Escape, or overlay click, all routed through onOpenChange. Focus trapping and return are Radix defaults; CaseDetail sets no onCloseAutoFocus, and on desktop the opener is not focusable, so focus is not returned to a meaningful element. The Close label is the hard-coded English 'Close'.

special_adjudications.question: 2f. Current source: long-text overflow in the case detail.
special_adjudications.answer: The sheet scrolls vertically (overflow-y-auto; max 85dvh on mobile). The source link uses break-all and the non-link source label break-words. Description, English gloss and contradictions paragraphs have no break utility, so they rely on normal wrapping; behaviour with a long unbroken token was not rendered. The longest description in the ledger is 1,250 characters and the longest source_url 555. The title has no reserved space for the absolutely positioned Close button.

special_adjudications.question: 2g. Current source: missing-field rendering in the case detail.
special_adjudications.answer: Witness and evidence type fall back to an em dash, the source falls back to 'Source not supplied' with a 'No URL' badge, and agency and contradictions are omitted when absent. The provenance line is not guarded: it interpolates reviewer_action, promoted_from, promoted_at and promoted_by directly, and in the current ledger candidate_id is null on all 470 rows and promoted_by is not a ledger key, so it renders as 'promote · from  · 2026-06-23 · ' with dangling separators. Tier, confidence and decade badges render empty if their value is missing. The existing test only asserts that at least one em dash appears.

special_adjudications.question: 3a. How source tiers, witness tiers and review state are shown on a case.
special_adjudications.answer: Evidence tier (T1-T4) is the only tier: a colour badge in the table, card, detail header and map point colour, with a legend that labels T1 'highest confidence' and T4 'lowest confidence'. There is no witness tier; witness is one plain-text line built from witness_type, count and name. 'Confidence' is a second unlabelled badge whose value is the first present of case_confidence, chronology_confidence, source_reliability - a number in the ledger - while the colour map expects high/medium/low words, so it is always slate. source_reliability, chronology_confidence, location_confidence, dedupe_status and translation_status are not displayed. Source is a citation/family/URL label, linked only for http(s) URLs, with a 'No URL' flag otherwise; source_family appears as an 'Agency involvement' badge tinted amber for military families. Review state on a master case is the review_action word inside the muted provenance line (it is 'promote' on all 470 rows). Candidates show review_status as a federation tone badge plus an evidence-tier badge.

special_adjudications.question: 3b. Whether the chronology/timeline has a non-visual (list/table) equivalent.
special_adjudications.answer: There is no case chronology or timeline visualisation in the dashboard. The 'Activity' view is a programme-workflow list of five hard-coded items; it is already text (phase, title, detail, category) but is built from <div> grids rather than a list or table. Time appears elsewhere only as a Date column in the cases table (no sort control, ledger order), the Period filter, the map date-range filter, and the 'Cases by decade' bar chart, which has no table equivalent.

special_adjudications.question: 4. Views are in-memory state with no URL: confirm, and state what a deep link to a view or to a single case would require.
special_adjudications.answer: Confirmed. The router declares only '/' and '*'. The mobile view is useState('cases'); the desktop view is an uncontrolled Radix Tabs with defaultValue 'cases' (a separate state from the mobile one, so crossing 860px resets it); the open case is a useState object; filters, page and page size are CaseGrid-local state. No file in dashboard/src uses useParams, useSearchParams or useNavigate. A view deep link would require one shared view value bound to the URL (search parameter or path segment) driving both a controlled Tabs and MobileNav, and working under HashRouter for the offline export. A case deep link would require a case id in the URL resolved either from the loaded /cases array or through GET /cases/{case_id}, which exists in the backend and as an unused client function; the offline snapshot has no per-case keys, so offline it must resolve from the /cases list. It also needs a not-found state for an unknown id, and SPA fallback for non-root paths in the desktop server, which lives in the external prii_desktop package and was not available to inspect.

denominator.coverage_statement: Exhaustive: routes (2), views/tabs (5), navigation items, dialogs/sheets (2), settings, context actions (none exist), keyboard shortcuts (none app-defined), backend endpoints (8 GET, all read), and every file under dashboard/src outside components/ui was read in full. Exhaustive for filters, tables, charts and toolbars inside each view as well; the application is small enough that nothing was sampled. The 38 unused shadcn primitives are counted as one unmounted surface, not individually. Not read: the Android/iOS native projects, the .command/.bat/.app launchers, and Python outside server/backend and desktop. Nothing was built, run or rendered; every layout, focus and overflow statement is a source reading. Test counts are grep counts of it()/test()/def test_.

unknowns: Runtime layout, focus order, contrast (including the light theme) and axe results: nothing was executed.
